1.

Our Jesus, Thou who art God Himself, Art worthy of power and glory, Thou delightest in the sound of our song of praise And the heart’s act of homage.

2.

May all that dwelleth above the sky, In air, in sea, on earth, Sing Thy glory, ever new, Though eternally, eternally traced.

3.

And the earth’s circuit from pole to pole Shall bear offerings of praise! In eternal power upon God’s throne Shall God’s Lamb reign.

4.

How blessed are they who then shall see Thee, Who stand in the throne’s radiance! Many thousands, thousands are they, But the joy is but one.
